title: AgentVerify input
description: A list of claims to check. Each one is checked independently and gives one result row.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Up to 1000 checks. Arithmetic example: {"calculation_type":"percentage","claimed_result":"25","inputs":{"part":"50","whole":"200"}}. Text example: {"calculation_type":"number_in_text","claimed_result":"3200000","unit":"$","allow_scaling":true,"source_text":"Seed funding was $3.2m in 2025."}. Types: arithmetic, subtract, multiply, divide, percentage, rental_yield, profit_margin, roi, compound_growth, loan_payment, quote_in_text, number_in_text, date_in_text.

signReceipts.title: Sign receipts
signReceipts.description: Attach an Ed25519-signed receipt to each result. Needs a signing key below. Billed as an extra event.

signingKey.title: Signing key
signingKey.description: Only for signed receipts: base64url of 32 random bytes that you generate and keep. Anyone holding it can issue receipts that verify as yours. Stored encrypted by Apify.
